Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick post-call recap + internal playbook for VentureCore pilot

Aisha — thanks again for the 30-minute walkthrough today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Call notes (high level)
- Champion: Aisha Khan (Platform Lead) — enthusiastic about faster embeddings and lower inference spend.
- Economic buyer: Marcus Shaw, VP Finance (we should get a sense for TCO target: annual spend delta vs. current infra).
- Security: Evan Rivera (appsec) asked for SOC2 evidence + short Q&A.
- Procurement: procurement@venturecore.com will own contract cadence; standard 3–4 week timeline flagged.

Pilot scope we agreed to
- 8-week pilot: 2 models (chat + embeddings), subset of traffic (~5k qps equivalent daily), PII redaction in path.
- Success metrics: <=100ms p95 for chat, 20–30% cost reduction per token for embeddings vs current baseline, functional parity on top-5 prompts.

Immediate asks / proposed owner
- Olga: Send ROI one-pager + SOC2 evidence summary (attached).
- Aisha: Introduce Marcus (econ buyer) + Evan (security) on this thread to align success metrics and procurement timing.
- Ben: Prepare draft pilot SOW and price/discount framing for a mid-sized POC.
- Priyom/Monica: Prepare CS onboarding checklist and expected checkpoints for weeks 0/2/6.

Attachments: Redwood-Pilot-ROI-1pager.pdf (ROI/ops assumptions), SOC2-evidence-summary.xlsx (controls summary + sample artifacts).

Aisha — would you be comfortable looping in Marcus + Evan here? If so, we'll propose two windows for a 30-min security deep-dive next week (Tue/Wed morning PT).

Thanks — speak soon.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

Subject: Internal: VentureCore pilot — enablement + pricing ask (internal playbook)

Team — moving this to internal so we can align on playbook and who owns each step. Copy of external thread below for context.

Key asks from external: intro to econ buyer + security tomorrow; procurement timeline ~3–4 weeks; PII handling clarification.

Proposed internal plan (short):
- Ben: Draft pilot commercial (list price, committed hours, discount band, optional add-on for dedicated burst). Aim for two options: conservative (no SLA, lower discount) and enterprise (SLA + faster ops). Target to send draft to Aisha before EOD Mon.
- Priyom: Lead technical onboarding scope and success criteria doc; include acceptance test prompts and p95 latency targets.
- Monica (CS): Draft week-by-week checkpoint plan and handoff to Customer Success after pilot.
- Olga: Champion enablement packet — one-page talk-track for Aisha to share with Marcus (economic framing, key ROI line items), and a short security blurb on data handling.

Champion talk-track draft (for Aisha) — short bullets you can paste into an internal note to Marcus:
- Projected 1-year savings: ~$85k (assumption: 3M embeddings/mo baseline; model/memory optimizations reduce cost by ~28%).
- Ops time savings: 30% fewer manual batching and infra ops with Redwood-managed runtime.
- Risk mitigation: automatic KV caching reduces repeated queries; Redwood supports customer-managed KMS and audit logs.

If Ben/ Priyom/Monica can confirm by EOD Mon I will assemble the packet and schedule the security sync windows.

—
Olga

Agree with the plan — adding price framing and negotiation play before Olga finalizes the champion packet.

Pricing notes (draft):
- List: $45k for 8-week pilot (includes model infra, 1st-line support, onboarding).
- Option A (Standard POC): $35k (no SLA, 15% discount) — good for teams that want quick evaluation.
- Option B (Pilot+SLA): $60k (includes 99.9% uptime for inference endpoints during pilot + 1 security deep-dive session), suggest 20% discount for mid-market comps.
- Add-on: Dedicated burst capacity during peak testing: $12k for the pilot period.

Negotiation play: lead with Option A as default; escalate to Option B if Marcus calls out reliability as a gating factor. Put a 30-day convert-to-paid clause in the SOW if metrics are met.

I'll mock a simple SOW and send to Olga for review by Mon AM. Priyom — can you confirm that the dedicated burst $12k number is feasible given the configuration we typically propose?

—
Ben Carter
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
